steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the washer or disconnect power before servicing. Discharge PBA terminals per manual. Replace all parts before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Make sure to disconnect the power plug before servicing.

steps.title: Inspect MEMS harness
steps.body: Check wire connections to MEMS PBA per §4-1. Look for loose connectors or harness damage.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check wire connections to MEMS PBA per §4-1. Look for loose connectors or harness damage.

steps.title: MEMS connections secure?
steps.body: All MEMS PBA connectors seated and harness intact?
steps.sourceExcerpt: All MEMS PBA connectors seated and harness intact?

steps.title: Replace MEMS PBA
steps.oemOutcome: Replace MEMS PBA when connections verified but 8C persists.

steps.title: MEMS path OK
steps.oemOutcome: Harness verified — replace MEMS PBA if code returns.
